acceptance.given: The Skill authoring standard draft is being evaluated against the frozen SM-A01 requirement.

oracle.expected: The standard document contains an explicit declaration of its inputs as part of the defined I/O contract.
forbidden: The standard omits any input definition or leaves the I/O inputs unspecified.
oracle.observable: During validation, the standard artifact's I/O section can be inspected and the inputs declaration is present.

acceptance.then: The validator or artifact check reports the inputs declaration as present and traceable to the standard's I/O definition.
acceptance.when: Run the SM-A01 validation case against the standard artifact and inspect the resulting structured assertion during the validation phase.

failure_intents.selector_intent: scripts/sc/tests/test_skill_quality_core.py::test_a01 must fail with an assertion identifying the missing standard input declaration and its relative artifact location when the I/O inputs definition is removed.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Define and validate the Skill authoring standard's required input declaration within its I/O contract.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: Removing this declaration restores the prior draft behavior; no persisted state or schema migration is required.

slice_hint.state_transition: The standard moves from an I/O contract without an explicit input definition to one that declares inputs and exposes that declaration to validation.
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: The targeted SM-A01 validator case and the whole applicable core test module complete with the input declaration assertion bound to A-SM-A01-DEPENDENCIES.
